note: The deployed tree has a single leaf: the governance Safe. The whole 8% TGE tranche is claimable by governance, which distributes it later through a second MerkleDistributor built from a real recipient list. There is no per-wallet snapshot yet, so proofs.json is intentionally empty and /api/airdrop returns 404 for every address. Do not repopulate it from a testnet snapshot -- proofs built against any other root revert InvalidProof on chain 4663.
